caseSystem.none: It relies on word order and prepositions to express grammatical relationships.
caseSystem.simple: It uses morphological marking to indicate basic grammatical relationships.
caseSystem.moderate: It uses extensive morphological processes to encode grammatical relationships.
caseSystem.complex: It uses complex morphological processes to encode grammatical relationships within words.
caseSystem.particle-based: It uses postpositional particles to mark grammatical relationships instead of inflectional cases.

caseCount.0: It relies on word order and prepositions to express grammatical relationships.
caseCount.1-4: It has {count} grammatical cases for basic syntactic distinctions.
caseCount.5-8: It has {count} grammatical cases, including locative distinctions.
caseCount.9-15: It has {count} grammatical cases with extensive spatial and semantic distinctions.
caseCount.16+: It has {count} grammatical cases with complex agglutinative morphology.

tonality.non-tonal: It is non-tonal, meaning pitch changes don't affect word meaning.
tonality.simple-tonal: It is tonal with a simple tone system, where pitch affects word meaning.
tonality.complex-tonal: It is tonal with a complex tone system, where pitch patterns significantly affect word meaning.
tonality.pitch-accent: It uses pitch accent, where certain syllables are emphasized with pitch changes.

morphology.isolating: It is isolating, meaning words typically consist of single morphemes.
morphology.agglutinative: It is agglutinative, meaning it forms words by adding affixes in sequence.
morphology.fusional: It is fusional, meaning it combines multiple grammatical meanings in single morphemes.
morphology.polysynthetic: It is polysynthetic, meaning it can express complex ideas in single words.

wordOrderFlexibility.rigid: It has rigid word order, with fixed grammatical positions.
wordOrderFlexibility.semi-flexible: It has semi-flexible word order, allowing some variation for emphasis.
wordOrderFlexibility.flexible: It has flexible word order, permitting various arrangements for stylistic purposes.
wordOrderFlexibility.very-flexible: It has very flexible word order, with extensive freedom in word arrangement.
